rollout.purpose: Baseline Viking observation and action contract.
Add a building replacement and a clan-specific building.
Add clan-specific economy and neutral-relation mechanics.
Add Signy state and copied-Lore choices to the Viking contract.
Add Forge-based warchief recruitment while retaining the shared building contract.

Bear.note: Bear's military action set must expose both its warchief and bear companion.

Raven.note: Harbor replaces the Longship Dock. Mercenary deployment targets an enemy coastal zone.

Boar.note: The future action mask must expose the Boar neutral-zone colonisation path only when its live requirements hold.

Snake.note: Snake has no Fame path. Signy begins in play and can be recruited after death.

Horse.note: Horse mines through warchiefs and recruits its warchiefs from ForgeHorse.

excluded_for_now.Lion: Kingdom worker, livability, and Farmstead transformation contract.
excluded_for_now.Dragon: Separate worker populations, Dragon Essence instead of happiness, rebellion risk, and a different military tree.
